## 1. General Requirements

### 1.1 Basis of preparation
This section describes the basis on which the sustainability-related financial disclosures in this report package have been prepared and presented.

The disclosures are prepared with reference to IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards requirements evidenced in internal governance documentation, including references to IFRS S2 paragraph-level considerations recorded in board materials (e.g., §6(a)(iii) and §6(a)(v)).

### 1.2 Statement of alignment with IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards
The organisation has indicated alignment with IFRS S2 in governance-related disclosures.

### 1.3 Governance evidence supporting preparation and oversight
The following internal evidence items support the preparation and oversight context for these disclosures:

- Board materials include references to IFRS S2 paragraph-level requirements (including §6(a)(iii) and §6(a)(v)).
- Governance records include multiple instances marked as IFRS S2 aligned.
revision_notes: Removed unsupported cross-reference statements about where governance alignment/oversight context is addressed and what the Governance section contains (previous connectivity note), as no evidence sources were provided for those claims (GR-007, GR-008).
Reworded the basis-of-preparation opening sentence to avoid asserting an evidence-backed basis beyond what is supported, while retaining the section’s descriptive purpose (addresses GR-001).
Corrected the stray entity artifact by removing the blockquote line break that created an invalid entity string ("IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards\nThe").
No new facts, dates, metrics, or governance structures were added; retained only evidence-supported statements tied to board minutes paragraph references and governance alignment flags.
